what_this_is: Bounded rehearsal of the judge-selected REAL evidence source, run through POST /v1/judge/run on a local instance of this application. Not a deployed-judge observation and not a physical-subscriber observation. Nothing here is a live-network claim: the Nokia account is in Simulator mode. These are the two CLI-driven runs; the three browser-driven runs of the same path are recorded in 2026-09-09-judge-browser-real-runs.json.
application_revision: working tree at 4b8fc6a plus the judge paired-source change

attempts.note: HTTP 200 was observed for this attempt. Its transport duration and exact transport timestamp were truncated out of the console output that was captured, and are NOT reconstructed: they stay null. The signed verdict for this chain does carry the investigator's own measurement of the same call, recovered below, which is a slightly wider interval than the transport figure (it includes normalization) and is not a substitute for it.

limitations: Local application rehearsal. This is not evidence of deployed judge access.
Nokia account is in Simulator mode. No live-network subscriber was contacted.
Only the two boolean swap checks were exposed and attempted. retrieve-date was disabled in both modes.
Gemini ran on the deployment's own key with a 3-call-per-run ceiling; its selections are not deterministic and a repeat run may choose a different order.
Durations are wall-clock at this application's transport, not a Nokia service-level measurement.
amendment: Amended after the runs, not during them. Two additions, no observation removed or changed: `driven_from` on each run, and — for the one attempt whose transport duration was truncated out of the captured output — the investigator's own measurement of the same call, recovered from the signed verdict and recorded under separate `chain_*` keys. The transport figures for that attempt stay null.
